body.message:
Apologies for the confusion. Unfortunately, we are unable to arrange the viewing tomorrow, as there is currently an in-house guest staying in the unit who is scheduled to check out on 23rd August.

Subject to the guest not extending their stay and no new bookings being received, we would be happy to arrange the viewing on 23rd August after the guest checks out.

We sincerely appreciate your understanding and apologize for any inconvenience caused
